title: Why Global Brands Entering India Are Turning to a Nepal-Based Distribution Giant - iDiva
description: Why Global Brands Entering India Are Turning to a Nepal-Based Distribution Giant  iDiva
publisher.title: iDiva
full_article:
India's consumer market is highly attractive but also challenging to enter. Fragmented retail networks, regional differences in consumer preferences, complex regulations, and varying supply chain conditions make market entry difficult for international brands. Vishal Group, based in Kathmandu, has spent nearly eight decades developing expertise to address these complexities.

For international brands pursuing an emerging-market strategy, Vishal Group has become a trusted partner. The company offers not only distribution reach but also the infrastructure, relationships, and local market knowledge needed to ensure products reach consumers.

A Business Built for Hard Markets

Founded in 1945 by the Agrawal family in Dharan, eastern Nepal, Vishal Group began as a trading business in a landlocked country with limited transport, fragmented retail, and restricted access to capital. Early on, the company developed its core strength: enabling distribution in challenging conditions.

This experience proved highly transferable. Similar challenges—limited infrastructure, dispersed retail, and regulatory complexity—exist across much of South Asia where growth is rising, but logistics and retail coverage remain inconsistent.

Instead of viewing these conditions as obstacles, Vishal Group built its business model to address them. Over decades, it invested in warehousing, logistics networks, route-to-market systems, and technology-driven distribution platforms, enabling reliable product movement in markets where conventional distributors often struggle.

What This Means for Brands Eyeing India

For global consumer brands in Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), beauty, luxury, or lifestyle, entering India requires more than securing shelf space in major cities. The main challenge is ensuring consistent product availability across a diverse retail landscape, from modern trade and e-commerce to millions of independent kiranas, each with unique ordering and stocking practices.

Vishal Group provides international brands with comprehensive market-entry support, including regulatory compliance, warehousing, logistics, sales execution, merchandising, marketing, and last-mile delivery. Instead of requiring brands to manage these elements separately, Vishal Group integrates them and acts as an operational partner in the market.

As Executive Director Arpit Agrawal has noted, the company's approach was shaped by hard-won experience in difficult markets. “Complex markets require local understanding.”

This philosophy is highly relevant in India, where even well-resourced global companies find that operational discipline and local market knowledge are as important as brand strength or marketing investment.

A Platform That Has Scaled Across Regions

Vishal Group's operations in India are part of a broader international presence. The company operates across South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa, partnering with leading global brands in FMCG, beauty, luxury, and hospitality. As a multi-billion-dollar business group with over 20,000 employees and a distribution infrastructure spanning multiple continents, Vishal Group demonstrates the scale needed to operate reliably in diverse regulatory and retail environments.

This international reach benefits brands partnering with Vishal Group in India. Companies expanding across Asia, the Middle East, and Africa gain from working with a single partner who understands each region's consumer markets, their differences, and the requirements for sustainable distribution.

The Bigger Opportunity

India's consumer market is defined by a growing middle class, rising aspirational spending, and increasing demand for premium international products across categories such as skincare, packaged food, and lifestyle goods. However, capturing this opportunity at scale, especially beyond major cities, requires robust distribution infrastructure that many brands underestimate when entering the market.

Vishal Group's nearly eight-decade history demonstrates what is required to build such infrastructure: patient investment, long-term relationships with retailers and suppliers, and a readiness to operate in markets where conditions are more complex than they appear on paper.

For international brands with significant ambitions in India and other emerging markets, the combination of deep local knowledge, proven logistics capability, and a long-term partnership approach is increasingly rare and more valuable than ever.

title: Devanaganj Incident Damages Nepal's Image of Religious Tolerance - Ratopati
description: Devanaganj Incident Damages Nepal's Image of Religious Tolerance  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Biratnagar. The tragic communal clash that occurred in the second week of July in Captainganj, Devanaganj Rural Municipality-3, Sunsari, and the subsequent security operation have dealt a serious blow not only to Nepal's internal peace and security but also to the image of religious tolerance and peace that Nepal has been building internationally.

The on-site study report prepared under the leadership of Engineer Deepak Kumar Sah, Member of Parliament from Sunsari Constituency No. 4, has pointed to the irresponsible use of social media and controversial statements by political leadership as the main causes of the incident.

Point number 13 of the report clearly identifies the influence of political and social media as the primary reason for the incident escalating to its peak. The report concludes that the statements made by various political figures, local leaders, and activists through social media after the Captainganj incident further agitated and sensitized the environment.

Specifically, the report suggests that the social media activities and public statements of Lalbikram Thapa, Member of Parliament elected from Sunsari Constituency No. 2, the then Chief District Officer (CDO), and local individuals Chandan Mehta, Kundan Mehta, and Ramkumar Mehta should be brought under investigation. They are accused of inflaming the public rather than calming them with the information they spread or the opinions they expressed.

Fabricated claims spread on social media, such as someone's hands and feet being cut off, or professional shooters arriving from outside, spread fear and a sense of revenge among the general public. It appears that these unsubstantiated and provocative materials caused a small local dispute to take on a communal dimension. The report emphasizes the need for factual verification of these claims and legal action against those responsible.

Nepal in the Eyes of International Media

This internal conflict in Nepal was not limited to the local level. International media outlets have begun to interpret it as a changing social character of Nepal. According to the report, the July 2026 Sunsari incident was defined as communal violence by the world-renowned news agency Reuters and broadcast with special priority. Reuters has exposed to the world how the clash, which started with a dispute over a religious flag and loud noise, took on a communal nature and claimed three lives.

Similarly, India's prestigious media outlet, Times of India, has also prominently reported that the tension originating from Sunsari spread to other districts of the Madhesh region, forcing the government to impose a strict curfew.

The report mentions that Nepal's international identity is shifting from that of a poor but peaceful country to a communally divided nation. Concerns have been expressed that this will damage Nepal's soft power in the long run.

Nepal's international brand is primarily established as a peaceful tourist destination. Sagarmatha, Buddha, and religious tolerance are the main attractions for foreign tourists. However, as pointed out in the report, news of religious clashes, road blockades, arson, and security forces firing shots sends a psychological message to foreign tourists that Nepal is unsafe.

The US State Department has already placed Nepal on its list of countries requiring increased vigilance. The main reasons for this are not only religious conflicts but also growing political instability and local unrest. If such incidents continue to occur, Nepal's tourism sector is likely to suffer irreparable damage.

Furthermore, this tension in the border area connected with India has also raised security concerns. According to Indian media, Indian authorities have increased security vigilance in border areas such as Madhubani in Bihar following the Sunsari incident. This indicates that Nepal's internal problems have now become a matter of cross-border security sensitivity.

The report considers the greatest danger to be Nepal being perceived as a country heading towards religious polarization. A dangerous cycle has been created where small local disputes are linked to religious identity, incited on social media, crowds are gathered, and violence is provoked. This cycle is destroying Nepal's long-standing social harmony.

International human rights organizations have also begun to question the rights of minorities and religious freedom in Nepal. Organizations like Freedom House have started considering the declining level of religious tolerance as a key indicator in the assessment of Nepal's democracy, as mentioned in the report.

सुनसरी निर्वाचन क्षेत्र नम्बर ४ के संसद सदस्य अभियंता दीपक कुमार साह के नेतृत्व में तैयार ऑन साइट अध्ययन रिपोर्ट में सोशल मीडिया के गैर जिम्मेदाराना उपयोग आ राजनीतिक नेतृत्व द्वारा विवादित बयान के घटना के मुख्य कारण बताओल गेल अछि।

रिपोर्ट केरऽ बिन्दु नंबर १३ म॑ ई घटना केरऽ चरम पर पहुँचै के प्राथमिक कारण के रूप म॑ राजनीतिक आरू सोशल मीडिया केरऽ प्रभाव क॑ स्पष्ट रूप स॑ पहचानलऽ गेलऽ छै । रिपोर्ट केरऽ निष्कर्ष छै कि कैप्टनगंज केरऽ घटना के बाद सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम स॑ विभिन्न राजनीतिक हस्ती, स्थानीय नेता, आरू कार्यकर्ता सिनी द्वारा देलऽ गेलऽ बयान न॑ पर्यावरण क॑ आरू आन्दोलित आरू संवेदनशील बनैलकै ।

विशेष रूप स सुनसरी निर्वाचन क्षेत्र नम्बर २ स निर्वाचित संसद सदस्य लालबिक्रम थापा, तत्कालीन मुख्य जिल्ला अधिकारी (सीडीओ), आ स्थानीय व्यक्ति चंदन मेहता, कुंदन मेहता, आ रामकुमार मेहता के सोशल मीडिया गतिविधि आ सार्वजनिक बयान के जांच के तहत आनल जाय के बात रिपोर्ट मे कहल गेल अछि। हुनका सब पर आरोप छै कि हुनी जे जानकारी फैलाबै छै या जे विचार व्यक्त करलकै ओकरा स॑ जनता क॑ शांत करै के बजाय ओकरा भड़काबै छै ।

सोशल मीडिया पर फैलल गढ़ल दावा, जेना ककरो हाथ-पैर काटि देल गेल, या बाहर सं प्रोफेशनल शूटर पहुंचल, आम जनता मे भय आ बदला लेबाक भाव फैलैत अछि. एहन बुझाइत अछि जे एहि निराधार आ भड़काऊ सामग्री सभक कारणेँ एकटा छोट सन स्थानीय विवाद साम्प्रदायिक आयाम ल' लेलक । रिपोर्ट म॑ ई दावा के तथ्यात्मक सत्यापन आरू जिम्मेदारऽ के खिलाफ कानूनी कार्रवाई के जरूरत प॑ जोर देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मिडियाके नज़रमे नेपाल

नेपाल मे ई आन्तरिक द्वंद्व मात्र स्थानीय स्तर धरि सीमित नहि छल । अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मीडिया एकर व्याख्या नेपालक बदलैत सामाजिक चरित्रक रूपमे करय लागल अछि । रिपोर्ट के अनुसार जुलाई २०२६ के सुनसरी घटना क॑ विश्व प्रसिद्ध समाचार एजेंसी रायटर न॑ सांप्रदायिक हिंसा के रूप म॑ परिभाषित करलकै आरू एकरऽ प्रसारण विशेष प्राथमिकता स॑ करलऽ गेलै । रायटर न॑ दुनिया के सामने खुलासा करलकै कि कोना धार्मिक झंडा आरू तेज आवाज के विवाद स॑ शुरू होलऽ ई झड़प सांप्रदायिक प्रकृति धारण करी क॑ तीन लोगऽ के जान ले गेलै ।

तहिना भारतक प्रतिष्ठित मीडिया टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया सेहो प्रमुखता सँ खबरि देलक अछि जे सुनसरी सँ उत्पन्न तनाव मधेश क्षेत्रक अन्य जिला मे सेहो पसरल अछि जाहि सँ सरकार केँ सख्त कर्फ्यू लगाबय पड़ल अछि ।

रिपोर्टमे उल्लेख अछि जे नेपालक अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय पहिचान गरीब मुदा शान्तिपूर्ण देशसँ साम्प्रदायिक रूपसँ विभाजित राष्ट्रमे बदलि रहल अछि । एहि स नेपाल क सॉफ्ट पावर कए दीर्घकाल मे नुकसान पहुंचेबाक चिंता व्यक्त कैल गेल अछि।

नेपालक अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय ब्रांड मुख्य रूपसँ शान्तिपूर्ण पर्यटन स्थलक रूपमे स्थापित अछि । सागरमाथा, बुद्ध, आ धार्मिक सहिष्णुता विदेशी पर्यटकक मुख्य आकर्षण थिक. मुदा, जेना कि रिपोर्ट में इंगित कयल गेल अछि, धार्मिक झड़प, सड़क नाकाबंदी, आगजनी, आ सुरक्षा बल के गोली चलाबय के खबर विदेशी पर्यटक के मनोवैज्ञानिक संदेश दैत अछि जे नेपाल असुरक्षित अछि.

अमेरिकी विदेश विभाग नेपाल के अपन सतर्कता बढ़ाबय वाला देश के सूची मे राखि चुकल अछि. एकरऽ मुख्य कारण खाली धार्मिक संघर्ष ही नै बल्कि बढ़तऽ राजनीतिक अस्थिरता आरू स्थानीय अशांति भी छै । अगर एहन घटना होइत रहत त नेपाल के पर्यटन क्षेत्र के अपूरणीय क्षति पहुंचय के संभावना अछि.

एकरऽ अलावा भारत स॑ जुड़लऽ सीमावर्ती क्षेत्र म॑ ई तनाव न॑ सुरक्षा के चिंता भी पैदा करी देल॑ छै । भारतीय मीडिया के अनुसार सुनसरी के घटना के बाद भारतीय अधिकारी बिहार के मधुबनी जकां सीमावर्ती इलाका मे सुरक्षा सतर्कता बढ़ा देलक अछि. एहिसँ नेपालक आन्तरिक समस्या आब सीमा पारक सुरक्षा संवेदनशीलताक विषय बनि गेल अछि ।

रिपोर्ट मे सबस पैघ खतरा मानल गेल अछि जे नेपाल कए धार्मिक ध्रुवीकरण दिस बढ़ैत देश क रूप मे बूझल जा रहल अछि। एकटा खतरनाक चक्र बनल अछि जतय छोट-छोट स्थानीय विवाद धार्मिक पहचान सं जुड़ल अछि, सोशल मीडिया पर भड़काओल जाइत अछि, भीड़ जमा भ जाइत अछि, आ हिंसा भड़कैत अछि. ई चक्र नेपालक दीर्घकालीन सामाजिक सौहार्द के नष्ट क रहल अछि ।

अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मानवाधिकार संगठन सेहो नेपालमे अल्पसंख्यकक अधिकार आ धार्मिक स्वतन्त्रता पर सवाल ठाढ़ करय लागल अछि । फ्रीडम हाउस सन संस्था नेपाल के लोकतंत्र के आकलन में धार्मिक सहिष्णुता के घटैत स्तर के एकटा प्रमुख सूचक के रूप में मानय लागल अछि, जेना कि रिपोर्ट में कहल गेल अछि।

title: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Lipulekh pass, calls it unjustified - News On AIR
description: India rejects Nepal’s objection to Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through Lipulekh pass, calls it unjustified  News On AIR
publisher.title: News On AIR
full_article:
India has rejected Nepal’s claim over Lipulekh Pass, termed it as a long-standing route for the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra since 1954 and the Yatra through this route has been going on for decades. Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal in a social media post said this in response to claims related to border issues made by Foreign Ministry of Nepal in the context of the annual Kailash Manasarovar Yatra.

He stressed that India’s position in this regard had been consistent and clear and this is not a new development. Mr Jaiswal pointed out that India has consistently maintained that such claims are neither justified nor based on historical facts and evidence. He stressed that such unilateral artificial enlargement of territorial claims is untenable. The spokesperson added that India remains open to a constructive interaction with Nepal on all issues in the bilateral relationship, including on resolving agreed outstanding boundary issues through dialogue and diplomacy.

title: Nepal thrash Karnataka by 116 runs in first warm-up match - OnlineKhabar English News
description: Nepal thrash Karnataka by 116 runs in first warm-up match  OnlineKhabar English News
publisher.title: OnlineKhabar English News
full_article:
Kathmandu, August 18

Nepal made an emphatic start to their preparations for the upcoming ACC Premier Cup, defeating Karnataka by 116 runs in their first practice match in India.

Batting first after winning the toss, Nepal were bowled out for 188 runs in 45 overs.

Aasif Sheikh top-scored for Nepal with 49 runs from 70 balls, hitting two fours and a six. Opener Dev Khanal contributed 27 off 43 balls with five fours, while Ishan Pandey scored 34 off 49 balls, hitting three fours.

Sundeep Jora added 27 off 37 balls with two fours, while Bashir Ahmed remained unbeaten on 19 from 27 balls.

Gulshan Jha scored 11 off 16 balls, while Rohit Paudel made four runs. Karan KC was dismissed without scoring, while captain Sandeep Lamichhane and Sher Malla scored two and one run respectively.

Nepal suffered an early setback when Arjun Kumal was dismissed for a duck after facing four balls. However, Aasif, Dev and Ishan steadied the innings and helped Nepal build a competitive total.

Karnataka’s Keerthi M was the standout bowler, taking five wickets for 20 runs from eight overs. Aditya Goel, Aravind Kumar Rai, Chirant Shivrudra, Sagar Gautam and Samarth Srinivas took one wicket each.

Karnataka collapse for 72

Chasing 189, Karnataka struggled against Nepal’s bowling attack and were bowled out for just 72 runs in 28 overs.

Sharath Srinivas was Karnataka’s top scorer with 32 runs from 65 balls, including three fours. Revanth Bairy scored 10, while Santosh Singh contributed nine.

The rest of Karnataka’s batting line-up failed to make an impact, with Lochan Gowda scoring two, Tushar Singh and Samarth Srinivas dismissed without scoring, and Sanjay Ashwin making one.

Ritesh Bhatkal scored six, Sagar Gautam was dismissed for a duck, Keerthi M made three and Aditya Goel scored six.

For Nepal, Karan KC led the bowling attack, taking two wickets for just nine runs in five overs.

Lalit Rajbanshi, Sher Malla and Bashir Ahmed also took two wickets each, while Sandeep Lamichhane claimed one.

The comprehensive victory gives Nepal a strong start to their warm-up campaign as they continue preparations for the ACC Premier Cup.

काठमांडू, १८ अगस्त

नेपाल आगामी एसीसी प्रीमियर कप के तैयारी के जोरदार शुरुआत केलक, भारत में अपन पहिल अभ्यास मैच में कर्नाटक के 116 रन स पराजित केलक।

टॉस जीतला के बाद पहिल बल्लेबाजी करैत नेपाल 45 ओवर मे 188 रन बना क आउट भ गेल।

नेपाल केरऽ तरफ सें आसिफ शेख न॑ ७० गेंद स॑ ४९ रन बनाबै के साथ सबसें अधिक स्कोर करलकै, जेकरा म॑ दू चौका आरू एक छक्का मारलकै । ओपनर देव खनाल न॑ ४३ गेंद प॑ ५ चौका के साथ २७ रन के योगदान देलकै, जबकि ईशान पांडे न॑ ४९ गेंद प॑ ३४ रन बनाबैत॑ तीन चौका मारलकै ।

सुदीप जोरा न॑ ३७ गेंद प॑ २ चौका के साथ २७ रन जोड़लकै, जबकि बशीर अहमद न॑ २७ गेंद स॑ १९ रन प॑ नाबाद रहलै ।

गुलशन झा 16 गेंद पर 11 रन बनौलनि, जखन कि रोहित पौडेल 4 रन बनौलनि। करण केसी बिना गोल केने आउट होय गेलै, जबकि कप्तान संदीप लामिछाने आरू शेर मल्ला न॑ क्रमशः दू आरू एक रन बनैलकै ।

नेपाल मे शुरुआती झटका लागल जखन अर्जुन कुमार चारि गेंदक सामना कए बतहा लेल आउट भ गेलाह। मुदा आसिफ, देव आ ईशान पारी स्थिर कए नेपाल कए प्रतिस्पर्धी कुल बनेबा मे मदद केलथि।

कर्नाटक केरऽ कीर्ति एम स्टैंडआउट गेंदबाज छेलै, जेकरा म॑ आठ ओवर म॑ २० रन प॑ ५ विकेट लेलकै । आदित्य गोएल, अरविंद कुमार राय, चिरंत शिवरुद्र, सागर गौतम आ समर्थ श्रीनिवास एक-एक विकेट लेलनि।

कर्नाटक 72 रन पर पतन

189 रन के पीछा करैत कर्नाटक नेपाल के गेंदबाजी के हमला के खिलाफ संघर्ष केलक आ 28 ओवर मे मात्र 72 रन के संग आउट भ गेल.

शरथ श्रीनिवास कर्नाटक केरऽ सर्वाधिक स्कोरर छेलै आरू ६५ गेंदऽ स॑ ३२ रन बनैलकै, जेकरा म॑ तीन चौका भी शामिल छेलै । रेवंत बैरी 10 रन बनेलनि, जखन कि संतोष सिंह 9 रन बनेलनि।

कर्नाटक केरऽ बाकी बल्लेबाजी लाइनअप केरऽ असर नै पड़॑ सकलऽ छेलै, जेकरा म॑ लोचन गौड़ा न॑ दू गोल, तुषार सिंह आरू समर्थ श्रीनिवास बिना गोल के आउट होय गेलै, आरू संजय अश्विन न॑ एक गोल करलकै ।

रितेश भटकल 6, सागर गौतम बतख के लेल आउट, कीर्ति एम तीन आ आदित्य गोएल 6 रन बनेलनि।

नेपाल के लेल करण केसी गेंदबाजी के आक्रमण के नेतृत्व केलनि, पांच ओवर में मात्र नौ रन पर दू विकेट लेलनि।

ललित राजबंशी, शेर मल्ला आरू बशीर अहमद न॑ भी दू-दू विकेट लेलकै, जबकि संदीप लामिछाने न॑ एक विकेट प॑ दावा करलकै ।

ई व्यापक जीत स॑ नेपाल क॑ अपनऽ वार्मअप अभियान केरऽ मजबूत शुरुआत मिलै छै, कैन्हेंकि ओकरा एसीसी प्रीमियर कप केरऽ तैयारी जारी छै ।

full_article:
Anil Kumar Sah will captain Nepal in the Top End T20 series.

Kathmandu, August 18

Nepal are set to make their second consecutive appearance in Australia’s Top End T20 Series, with the Nepal A team heading to Darwin for the tournament beginning August 21.

Unlike last year, when Nepal sent its senior national team, the Cricket Association of Nepal (CAN) has selected a 15-member Nepal A squad for this year’s tournament. Anil Kumar Sah will captain the side.

The senior team’s commitments in the ACC Premier Cup have prompted CAN to send the A team to Australia.

The tournament will provide Nepal’s emerging players with exposure to Australian conditions and competitive opposition. Nepal will play six league matches against NT Strike, Bangladesh High Performance, Hobart Hurricanes Academy, ACT Comets, Kingsmen and Victoria CA XI.

Nepal will open its campaign against NT Strike on August 21 before facing Bangladesh High Performance on August 22. The team will then play Hobart Hurricanes Academy on August 24, ACT Comets on August 26, Kingsmen on August 27 and Victoria CA XI on August 29.

Building on last year’s experience

Nepal made its Top End T20 debut last year with the senior national team. It won two of its six league matches and lost four.

Nepal defeated Hobart Hurricanes Academy and Melbourne Renegades Academy but lost to Melbourne Stars Academy, NT Strike, Bangladesh A and Pakistan Shaheens.

Five players from last year’s squad—Kushal Bhurtel, Kushal Malla, Lokesh Bam, Rupesh Singh and Shah Alam—are returning for the tournament this year.

Bhurtel’s inclusion gives the A team an added boost. The regular national team member has been rested from ODI cricket for a period and has been included in the squad for the T20 tournament.

Captain Sah said the tournament would be a major opportunity for the players.

“Our preparations have been good. We have also spoken to senior players about the conditions there and learned how to prepare mentally,” Sah said. “Playing this tournament as Nepal A is a big opportunity and will provide valuable exposure.”

A test ahead of the Asian Games

The Top End T20 Series will also serve as an important preparation platform for players hoping to make Nepal’s squad for the Asian Games in Japan, which begin on September 24.

Several players involved in the tournament are part of Nepal’s preliminary Asian Games plans, although the final squad could change after the Australia tour.

Nepal can play at least six matches in the Top End T20. If it reaches the semi-finals and final, the team could play up to eight matches.

Nepal’s 15-member squad

Anil Kumar Sah (captain), Kushal Bhurtel, Lokesh Bam, Trit Raj Das, Mayan Yadav, Pawan Sarraf, Dipak Dumre, Kushal Malla, Rashid Khan, Narayan Joshi, Aakash Chand, Shahab Alam, Bipin Khatri, Yuvraj Khatri and Rijan Dhakal.

Nepal’s Top End T20 fixtures

August 21: vs NT Strike

August 22: vs Bangladesh High Performance

August 24: vs Hobart Hurricanes Academy

August 26: vs ACT Comets

August 27: vs Kingsmen

August 29: vs Victoria CA XI

The 2026 Top End T20 Series runs from August 21 to 30 in Darwin.

टॉप एंड टी-20 सीरीज मे अनिल कुमार साह नेपाल क कप्तान बनताह।

काठमांडू, १८ अगस्त

ऑस्ट्रेलिया केरऽ टॉप एंड टी-२० सीरीज म॑ नेपाल लगातार दोसरऽ बार खेलै वाला छै, जेकरा म॑ नेपाल ए टीम २१ अगस्त स॑ शुरू होय वाला ई टूर्नामेंट लेली डार्विन जाय रहलऽ छै ।

पिछला साल जखन नेपाल अपन वरिष्ठ राष्ट्रीय टीम पठेलक तखन क्रिकेट संघ नेपाल (सीएएन) एहि बेरक टूर्नामेंट लेल 15 सदस्यीय नेपाल ए टीमक चयन केलक अछि। अनिल कुमार साह टीमक कप्तान बनताह।

एसीसी प्रीमियर कप म॑ सीनियर टीम केरऽ प्रतिबद्धता के वजह स॑ कैन न॑ ए टीम क॑ ऑस्ट्रेलिया भेजलकै ।

ई टूर्नामेंट स॑ नेपाल केरऽ उभरतऽ खिलाड़ी क॑ ऑस्ट्रेलिया केरऽ परिस्थिति आरू प्रतिस्पर्धी विरोध के संपर्क म॑ आबै के मौका मिलतै । नेपाल एनटी स्ट्राइक, बांग्लादेश हाई परफॉर्मेंस, होबार्ट हरिकेन्स एकेडमी, एसीटी कॉमेट्स, किंग्समेन आ विक्टोरिया सीए इलेवन के खिलाफ छह लीग मैच खेलत।

नेपाल 21 अगस्त कए एनटी स्ट्राइक क खिलाफ अभियान शुरू करत आ 22 अगस्त कए बांग्लादेश हाई परफॉर्मेंस क सामना करत।तखन टीम 24 अगस्त कए होबार्ट हरिकेन्स एकेडमी, 26 अगस्त कए एक्ट कॉमेट्स, 27 अगस्त कए किंग्समेन आ 29 अगस्त कए विक्टोरिया सीए इलेवन स मुकाबला करत।

पिछला साल’क अनुभव पर आधारित

नेपाल पिछला साल सीनियर राष्ट्रीय टीम के संग टॉप एंड टी-20 के शुरुआत केने छल। अपनऽ छह लीग मैचऽ म॑ स॑ दू मैच जीती क॑ ४ मैच हारलऽ छेलै ।

नेपाल होबार्ट हरिकेन्स एकेडमी आ मेलबर्न रेनेगेड्स एकेडमी के पराजित केलक मुदा मेलबर्न स्टार एकेडमी, एनटी स्ट्राइक, बांग्लादेश ए आ पाकिस्तान शाहीनस स हारल छल ।

पिछला साल के टीम के पांच खिलाड़ी कुशल भूर्टेल, कुशल मल्ला, लोकेश बम, रूपेश सिंह आओर शाह आलम एहि साल एहि टूर्नामेंट के लेल वापसी क रहल छथिन्ह.

भूर्टेल केरऽ शामिल होय स॑ ए टीम क॑ एगो आरू बढ़ावा मिलै छै । नियमित राष्ट्रीय टीम के सदस्य क॑ एक अवधि लेली वनडे क्रिकेट स॑ आराम देलऽ गेलऽ छै आरू टी-२० टूर्नामेंट लेली टीम म॑ शामिल करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

कप्तान साह नँ कहलकै कि ई टूर्नामेंट खिलाड़ी सिनी लेली एगो बड़ौ अवसर होतै ।

साह कहलनि जे, हमर सबहक तैयारी नीक रहल अछि, हम सब सीनियर खिलाड़ी सब स सेहो ओतय के हालत के बारे में बात केलहुं आ मानसिक रूप स तैयारी के तरीका सीखलहुं। “नेपाल ए के रूप में ई टूर्नामेंट खेलना एकटा पैघ अवसर अछि आ मूल्यवान एक्सपोजर भेटत।”

एशियाई खेल स आगू एकटा परीक्षा

टॉप एंड टी-20 सीरीज जापान म॑ होबै वाला एशियाई खेलऽ लेली नेपाल केरऽ टीम बनाबै के उम्मीद करै वाला खिलाड़ी लेली भी एगो महत्वपूर्ण तैयारी मंच के रूप म॑ काम करतै, जे 24 सितंबर स॑ शुरू होय रहलऽ छै ।

ई टूर्नामेंट स॑ जुड़लऽ कईएक खिलाड़ी नेपाल केरऽ एशियाई खेलऽ के प्रारंभिक योजना के हिस्सा छै, हालांकि ऑस्ट्रेलिया दौरा के बाद अंतिम टीम म॑ बदलाव आबी सकै छै ।

टॉप एंड टी-20 मे नेपाल कम स कम छह मैच खेल सकैत अछि। अगर ई सेमीफाइनल आरू फाइनल म॑ पहुँची जाय छै त॑ टीम आठ मैच तलक खेली सकै छै ।

नेपालक १५ सदस्यीय दस्ता

अनिल कुमार साह (कप्तान), कुशल भूर्टेल, लोकेश बम, त्रित राज दास, मायान यादव, पवन सर्राफ, दीपक डुमरे, कुशल मल्ला, रशीद खान, नारायण जोशी, आकाश चंद, शहाब आलम, बिपिन खत्री, युवराज खत्री एवं रिजन ढकाल।

नेपाल के टॉप एंड टी-20 फिक्सर

27 अगस्त : बनाम किंग्समैन

full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 18: The Last rites of Nepali and Nepal Bhasa senior poet Durgalal Shrestha were performed with national honour.

Shrestha, who passed away at his Budhanilkantha-based residence on Sunday night at the age of 93, was cremated at Shovabhagawati on Tuesday evening.

On the occasion, Home Minister Sudhan Gurung, Minister for Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation, Biraj Bhakta Shrestha, Acting Mayor of Kathmandu Metropolitan City, Sunita Dangol, as well as other senior personalities paid last tributes to late Shrestha.

Earlier, a procession carrying the mortal remains of Shrestha had started from Shova Bhagawati and concluded after reaching the same place going through Chhetrapati, Thahiti, Bangemuda, Asan, Janabahal, Kilagal and Nardevi.

Senior personalities of different sectors, litterateurs, artists, musicians, well-wishers and general people also paid tributes to late Shrestha.

With the demise of Shrestha, Nepali literature has lost a powerful literary figure, who built a literary bridge between Nepal Bhasa and Nepali language. He spent more than seven decades in the promotion of poem, song, child literature, drama and Nepal Bhasa for around seven decades.

Madan Puraskar Guthi had honoured Shrestha with the 'Jagadamba-Shree' award for his contribution on literature sector.

Born in 1992 BS in Kathmandu, Shrestha's first poem 'Dui Thopa' was published in 2009. The famous songs --'Saya Thari Baja Eutai Taal', 'Phoolko Aankhanma Phoolai Sansara' are Shrestha's creations. (RSS)

काठमांडू, 18 अगस्त : नेपाली एवं नेपाल भासा के वरिष्ठ कवि दुर्गलाल श्रेष्ठ के अंतिम संस्कार राष्ट्रीय सम्मान के साथ किया गया।

९३ वर्षक उमेरमे रविदिन राति बुधनीलकान्त स्थित आवासमे निधन भेल श्रेष्ठके मंगलदिन साँझ शोवाभागवतीमे अंतिम संस्कार कएल गेल ।

एहि अवसर पर गृहमंत्री सुधन गुरुंग, ऊर्जा, जल संसाधन आ सिंचाई मंत्री, बिराज भक्त श्रेष्ठ, काठमांडू महानगरपालिका के कार्यवाहक मेयर सुनीता डंगोल के संग संग अन्य वरिष्ठ हस्ती लोकनि स्वर्गीय श्रेष्ठ के अंतिम श्रद्धांजलि देलनि।

एहि सँ पहिने शोवा भगवती सँ श्रेष्ठक नश्वर अवशेष लऽ कऽ शोभायात्रा क्षेत्रपति, थाहिती, बंगेमुडा, आसन, जनबहल, किलागल आ नरदेवी होइत ओही स्थान पर पहुँचलाक बाद समाप्त भेल छल ।

विभिन्न क्षेत्र के वरिष्ठ व्यक्तित्व, साहित्यकार, कलाकार, संगीतकार, शुभचिंतक आ सामान्य लोक सब सेहो स्वर्गीय श्रेष्ठ के श्रद्धांजलि देलखिन।

title: India-Nepal defence ties in focus as Army chief meets PM Balendra Shah - India Today
description: India-Nepal defence ties in focus as Army chief meets PM Balendra Shah  India Today
publisher.title: India Today
full_article:
Indian Army chief General Dhiraj Seth on Tuesday met Nepal Prime Minister and Defence Minister Balendra Shah and held what the Indian Embassy described as a "warm and productive discussion" on strengthening defence cooperation between the two countries. Indian Ambassador to Nepal Naveen Srivastava was also present at the meeting at the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers.

advertisement ❮❯

Read Full Story

The meeting took place during a period of unease in ties between India and Nepal. According to sources at the Prime Minister's secretariat, the two sides discussed matters of bilateral interest and ways to strengthen military relations between the neighbours.

Earlier this month, Shah held his first one-on-one meeting with Ambassador Srivastava and stressed the need to deepen Nepal's "historic relationship" with India. In recent weeks, Shah has moved away from his self-imposed rule of avoiding one-on-one engagements with foreign ambassadors and senior visiting officials.

General Seth is on a four-day official visit to Nepal from August 17 to 19 at the invitation of his Nepali counterpart, General Ashok Raj Sigdel. On Monday, President Ramchandra Paudel conferred on him the rank of Honorary General of the Nepali Army at a ceremony in Kathmandu. Nepal and India have followed a longstanding tradition since 1950 of conferring the honorary rank of General on each other's army chiefs, in what has been described as a unique and time-honoured military practice.

General Seth also held bilateral talks with General Sigdel at the Army Headquarters on Monday, where they discussed matters of mutual interest. The Indian Embassy in Kathmandu said the visit "reaffirms the unique and time-tested defence relations between India and Nepal, which are rooted in shared values, mutual trust, and enduring military-to-military ties".

The visit comes against the backdrop of wider political developments in Nepal's engagement with its neighbours. Nepal's leaders have traditionally attached importance to early engagement with New Delhi because of the close political, economic and people-to-people ties between the two countries. Shah, however, has not visited either India or China since taking office. Instead, Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal made back-to-back visits to New Delhi and Beijing in June. Shah's predecessor K P Sharma Oli had visited China after taking over in 2024, departing from the earlier practice of Nepal's prime ministers making India their first foreign visit.

In his first appearance in Parliament on May 31, Shah had said he had learnt about his country "encroaching" territories in India. He also said that apart from discussions with India on the long-running border dispute, Kathmandu was in touch with China and the UK as well. Two days later, New Delhi rejected any role for third parties in resolving its boundary dispute with Nepal. The two countries have an old dispute over Lipulekh, Limpiyadhura and Kalapani, which India has consistently maintained are part of Uttarakhand. Soon after Shah's remarks, Nepal's ruling Rastriya Swatantra Party chairman Rabi Lamichhane visited India and met top Indian leaders.

He also offered prayers at the Pashupatinath Temple in Kathmandu on Tuesday, Nepal Army sources said. description: Bangladeshi scientist receives UK exploration award for Nepal Indigenous knowledge project  The Daily Star
publisher.title: The Daily Star
full_article:
Abdullah Rubaet Chowdhury, a Bangladeshi social scientist and anthropologist, has received the SES Elodie Sandford Award from the UK-based Scientific Exploration Society (SES) for a planned research expedition documenting Indigenous ecological knowledge in Nepal’s Himalayan Mustang region.

The award will support a year-long expedition focused on Nepal's Bönpo community, which is home to one of the world’s oldest continuous knowledge traditions dating back 18,000 years, and its approaches to the natural environment.

Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source

Rubaet Chowdhury said the research would examine how Bönpo practitioners respond to environmental and climatic changes through knowledge rooted in their relationship with nature.

“Our expedition is particularly interested in learning how Bönpo practitioners, placed at the forefront of the climate crisis, have maintained a strong kinship with nature and natural entities driven by their ‘living knowledge’ to face these challenges,” he said.

The expedition is expected to take place in the Mustang region around the Kali Gandaki Gorge, an environmentally and culturally distinctive area of the trans-Himalayan landscape.

According to the expedition team, the project will use a collaborative research model intended to avoid treating Indigenous knowledge simply as information to be extracted by outside researchers.

Rubaet Chowdhury and his team plan to work with Bön spiritual leaders and young people using an ethnophotography-based approach. The researchers say they will jointly develop biodiversity conservation indicators, participatory maps and a community-owned field film.

The project aims to connect local environmental practices with contemporary biodiversity policy while allowing the community to retain ownership of the knowledge and materials produced during the research.

Findings from the expedition are expected to be shared with bodies involved in implementing the UN Global Biodiversity Framework, including the secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity, as well as Nepal’s Ministry of Forests and Environment, according to the press release.

The team also plans exhibitions and academic presentations, including at Heidelberg University’s ethnographic museum and institutions in Nepal.

The Scientific Exploration Society is a UK organisation that supports expeditions combining scientific research, exploration and conservation.

title: Nepal Cricket Team Secures Dominant Victory Against Karnataka in Practice Match - Ratopati
description: Nepal Cricket Team Secures Dominant Victory Against Karnataka in Practice Match  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. The Nepali national men's cricket team, currently on a tour of India for the preparation of the third edition of the ACC Premier Cup, has registered a wide victory in its first practice match.

In its winning start, Nepal defeated the Karnataka state-level team by 116 runs in the first match played today. Nepal, choosing to bat first after winning the toss, was all out for 188 runs in 45 overs. Opening batter Aasif Sheikh played the highest innings of 49 runs off 70 balls, including two fours and one six.

Ishan Pandey scored 34, Dev Khanal and Sandeep Jora scored 27/27 each, Bashir Ahmed remained unbeaten on 19, and Gulshan Kumar Jha added 11 runs. Kriti M from Karnataka took the highest five wickets, giving away 20 runs in eight overs, including one maiden.

Chasing the target of 189 runs set by Nepal, Karnataka was all out for just 72 runs in 28 overs. Sharath Shrivastava scored the highest 32 runs off 65 balls, including three fours. Although he remained unbeaten, other Karnataka batsmen were dismissed cheaply.

In Nepal's bowling effort to dismiss Karnataka cheaply, Karan KC, Lalit Narayan, Sher Malla, and Bashir Ahmed took two wickets each. Similarly, captain Sandeep Lamichhane and Hemant Dhami took one wicket each.

Nepal has scheduled another practice match in India. After completing a 10-day training, the Nepali team will depart from India for Malaysia to play in the Premier Cup. The Nepali team is preparing to play the tournament after three days of practice in Malaysia. Nepal, placed in Group 'A', will face Bahrain in its first match on September 1. After that, Nepal will play against Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, and Hong Kong in the tournament.

अपन जीत के शुरुआत मे नेपाल आइ खेलल गेल पहिल मैच मे कर्नाटक राज्य स्तरीय टीम के 116 रन स पराजित केलक अछि। टॉस जीतला के बाद पहिने बल्लेबाजी करय के फैसला करय वाला नेपाल 45 ओवर मे 188 रन बना क ऑल आउट भ गेल छल. ओपनिंग बल्लेबाज आसिफ शेख न॑ ७० गेंद प॑ ४९ रन के सबस॑ अधिक पारी खेललकै, जेकरा म॑ दू चौका आरू एक छक्का शामिल छेलै ।

ईशान पाण्डेय न॑ ३४, देव खनाल आरू संदीप जोरा न॑ २७/२७, बशीर अहमद १९ रन प॑ नाबाद रहलै, आरू गुलशन कुमार झा न॑ ११ रन जोड़लकै । कर्नाटक केरऽ कृति एम न॑ सबसें जादा ५ विकेट लेलकै, जेकरा म॑ एक मेडेन सहित आठ ओवर म॑ २० रन देलकै ।

नेपाल द्वारा निर्धारित 189 रन के लक्ष्य के पीछा करैत कर्नाटक 28 ओवर मे मात्र 72 रन बना क ऑल आउट भ गेल छल। शरथ श्रीवास्तव 65 गेंद पर सबस बेसी 32 रन बनेलथि, जाहि मे तीन चौका शामिल छल। ओना ओ अपराजित रहलाह, मुदा कर्नाटकक अन्य बल्लेबाज सस्ता मे आउट भ गेलाह।

कर्नाटक क॑ सस्ता म॑ बर्खास्त करै के नेपाल केरऽ गेंदबाजी प्रयास म॑ करण केसी, ललित नारायण, शेर मल्ला, आरू बशीर अहमद न॑ दू-दू विकेट लेलकै । तहिना कप्तान संदीप लामिछाने आ हेमंत धामी एक-एक विकेट लेलनि ।

नेपाल भारत मे एकटा आओर अभ्यास मैच निर्धारित केलक अछि । १० दिन के प्रशिक्षण पूरा केलाक बाद नेपाली टीम भारत सँ मलेशिया प्रस्थान क प्रीमियर कप खेलय लेल प्रस्थान करत । नेपाली टीम मलेशिया मे तीन दिनक अभ्यास के बाद एहि टूर्नामेंट के खेलय के तैयारी मे अछि. ग्रुप ‘ए’ मे रहल नेपाल के पहिल मैच मे बहरीन के सामना 1 सितंबर के होयत.तकर बाद नेपाल एहि टूर्नामेंट मे मलेशिया, सऊदी अरब, आ हांगकांग के खिलाफ खेलत.

MAW Vriddhi Motors, the authorized importer of Dongfeng Nammi in Nepal, is set to launch the new Nammi Vigo E2 on August 19, 2026. The new version of the Nammi Vigo will be positioned as a “Full SUV.”

The Vigo E2 aims to offer customers a complete SUV experience through generous space, modern features and practical performance.

The launch builds on Nammi’s strong customer acceptance in Nepal, with more than 2,000 Nammi vehicles already running on the country’s roads.

Vigo has also demonstrated its capability across Manang, Mustang, Shuklaphanta and other challenging destinations. These real-world journeys have helped establish Vigo as a proven and dependable electric SUV.

The new Vigo E2 will carry forward Vigo’s strong SUV presence, spacious cabin and practical performance. It is designed for customers seeking a capable electric SUV for everyday use and longer journeys.

As per the company claims, the official price and complete product information will be announced at the launch on August 19.
